text.p: Penn-America Group Inc said Friday its 3.5 million share secondary public offering of common stock was priced at $15.75 per share.
A registration statement relating to the offering was declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission yesterday, the company said.
In the offering, 2.5 million shares are being offered by the company, and 1 million shares are being offered by Penn Independent Corp, it said.
The managing underwriters of the offering are Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Conning & Co and Pennsylvania Merchant Group Ltd, it said.
The company said it has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase an additional 525,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to repay $9 million of existing bank debt, to increase the policyholders' surplus of its insurance subsidiaries and for general corporate purposes.
The trading price Friday morning of the company's existing stock was $17.25 per share.
